# Startup Grind

> Global community platform connecting 120+ countries of entrepreneurs, founders, and investors through local chapters, membership programs, events, and curated resources.

Startup Grind operates a worldwide network of startup chapters and community leaders, offering membership tiers for both founders and investors, pitch competitions, educational resources, and partnerships with leading startup tools and venture capital firms. The platform facilitates founder networking, investor access, and entrepreneurial support through in-person events and digital resources.

## Key Topics

- Startup Community
- Entrepreneurship
- Venture Capital
- Early-Stage Startups
- Pitch Events
- Founder Networking
- Investor Membership
- Local Chapters
- Founder Resources
- Community Management
- Mentorship & Office Hours
- International Expansion
- Startup Support
- Chapter Engagement
- Sequoia Capital

## Membership Programs

- [Startup Membership | Startup Program](https://startup.startupgrind.com): Startup membership program for founders seeking education and investor access
- [Investor Membership | Startup Grind](https://startup.startupgrind.com/investor-membership): Investor membership program connecting VCs with early-stage founders globally

- [Startup Mania 2026 | Startup Grind](https://about.startupgrind.com/startup-mania-2026): Startup Mania 2026: March Madness-style pitch competition in Austin
